description:
Done at the request of KilloZapit this pack includes the cake and wineglass FG as well as the Starry night and Chocolate cake BG it also includes separate palettes for all 4 or the combined palettes of wineglass and starry night or combined of cake and chocolate cake.

Moderator's note: optimized the graphics files so they only use FG3 and BG1, fixed palettes as they were overwriting status bar colors, added palmasks and fixed and optimized Map16.
